research_question: 在相同任务、数据和验收门禁下，结构化意图与 Goal Prompt 是否比仅给场景和 must-have 的弱 Prompt 带来更高的最终发布率？

frozen_runtime.workspace_policy: fresh run-scoped workspace per case and variant

failure_taxonomy.measurement_block: acceptance child or test environment cannot execute
failure_taxonomy.builder_output_failure: CLI started and artifact reached acceptance but final publication failed
failure_taxonomy.release_regression: candidate was staged but fresh post-publish audit failed

primary_metric: published and fresh post-publish audit passed / selected cases
pilot_rule: Run each selected case once under each profile with fresh run-scoped workspaces; do not reuse artifacts or carry forward passes.
